content.comment_body: Hello. On page 6 of this booklet, [product_name] V8.2 with article number [article_no] is mentioned. When will users have access to it? [user_name]

New software version [version_no], new order number [article_no]. The updated [product_name] includes a website editor, which will be available with new base modules and offered for free. It is expected to be downloadable later. Devices with new article numbers and the updated software should become available by mid to end of December 2017.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are requesting specific information regarding the release and availability of the latest [product_name] software, especially the date and distribution method. The new features and updated article numbers generate considerable interest. The absence of an exact timeline is leading to uncertainty in planning and adoption.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear and prompt updates concerning the release timing and download access of the new software and related hardware.
